description: Babysit every agent-opened pull request (ADR-0004; opt out with IPE_BABYSIT_PR_HOOK=off). State the standing compound-engineering:lfg rule at every session start (standing-lfg.sh). Log each Skill call as one JSON line to measure adherence to that rule (skill-call-log.sh, temporary). Stage each new compound-engineering artifact (docs/plans, ideation, brainstorms, adr, solutions) at write time, and name uncommitted ones at Stop (stage-ce-artifact.sh, warn-untracked-ce-artifacts.sh; ADR-0006; opt out with IPE_CE_ARTIFACT_HOOKS=off, override directories with IPE_CE_ARTIFACT_DIRS).
